notes.title: Play The Jackbox Survey Scramble Today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948640/The_Jackbox_Survey_Scramble/

Jackbox has made an all-new party experience! Taking real surveys from real people around the globe, The Jackbox Survey Scramble is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

[h3][b]Multiple New Game Modes[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Hilo:[/b] Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.
[*] [b]Speed:[/b] In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?
[*] [b]Squares:[/b] Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares.
[*] [b]Bounce:[/b] In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer![/list]
[b]But wait… there’s more! We’ll be releasing a free game update featuring two new game modes in a couple months 👀 So what are you waiting for? Get The Jackbox Survey Scramble now for just $9.99 USD.[/b]



[i]Play with your phone or tablet - no special controller required. All games support 2 to 8 players and 10,000 audience members. All Jackbox Survey Scramble games can be played in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian or Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. And we'll be making sure we have localized answers for the UK and Australia, as well.[/i]

What’s The Jackbox Naughty Pack? I’m so pleased you asked. Take a seat on my perfectly maintained 70s chic conversation pit couch, grab at least two friends, and get ready for an absolutely raucous game night. 

The Jackbox Naughty Pack is rated M for Mature. Watch the trailer to learn more here:

 [previewyoutube=FTAYOPKYDuU;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready to play three tantalizingly silly party games, each supporting 3-8 players:
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Fakin’ It All Night Long[/b][/h3] (Social Deduction): Fakin’ It returns and this time we’re putting it all out there. Everyone gets a secret task except the Faker, who tries to blend in. Find out which of your friends is the best liar… and SO much more! Featuring new categories and a brand new “remote play” mode. 
[*] [h3][b]Dirty Drawful[/b][/h3] (Drawing, Guessing): It’s Drawful, but  dirty… It’s Dirty Drawful. We’ve taken the Drawful that you love and added spicy prompts to ensure your drawings are both terrible and titillating. We also may have added an “undo” button for this one, but don’t tell anyone. 
[*] [h3][b]Let Me Finish[/b][/h3] (Debate): Let Me Finish is Jackbox’s new presentation game that examines life’s serious questions like, “Where is the mailbox’s butt?” or “How does this avocado get aroused?” Everyone gets a chance to speak their mind but will others pick up what you’re putting down?
[/list]
The Jackbox Naughty Pack will launch this Thursday, [b]September 12, 2024[/b] and retail for [b]$21.69[/b] ([i]nice[/i]). This product will be available on all major platforms upon release.

notes.title: The Jackbox Megapicker - Coming Soon to a PC Near You
notes.content:
Over the past ten years, we have been lucky enough to have created a ton of games and become part of your life. We have helped entertain your friends and family when you wanted to break the ice, laugh, or for those nights when you just wanted to stop your weird uncle from talking. (We aren’t going to name names, but you know who we’re talking about.) 

However, with over 50 games, more and more you are saying that it takes a lot of effort to switch between packs to find all of the different games you want to play. In fact, here are some of the things we’ve heard directly from our players through social media, customer feedback surveys, and through hand-written pleas:

[i]“It's the only annoying thing about Jackbox at parties. Having a unified megapicker that recognizes purchases would be great.”

“I think it'd be awesome if they just had a singular unified Jackbox launcher that Party Packs would just add into, so I don't have to remember which pack had which game and go through the hassle of switching between them.”

“How has Jackbox released seven party packs and not a unified combo-pack launcher?”[/i]

[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2466364192779466038/C418A2350ABBBC6CC247C479DFBFA8231A94A104/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Enter The Jackbox Megapicker:[/b][/h2] 
A free product exclusive to Steam, where you can view your game library, sort and filter the games you love, and quickly launch an evening of fun.[b]The Megapicker will be released July 2024[/b], so stay tuned for more information here on Steam, on our social media, or join us for a [b]Reddit AMA on r/jackboxgames[/b] with the team around launch.

If you have a feature request, drop us a line on social media. We do listen!

notes.title: The Jackbox Decade Bundle Is Out Now
notes.content:
[h3]Wow! Ten years of Party Packs! So much has happened during this past decade, and none of it has been vaguely apocalyptic, right? . . . [i][b]RIGHT??[/b][/i][/h3]

The Jackbox Decade Bundle is great for anyone looking to guarantee they’ll never have to deal with figuring out what to do with friends again, or as a gift to ensure your loved one is set for every party for the rest of their lives.

[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/bundles/the-jackbox-decade-bundle][img]https://shop.jackboxgames.com/cdn/shop/files/19_PP10_TKO2-0030_Upscaled_1024x1024@2x.png?v=1712185770[/img][/url]

[h3]What is the Jackbox Decade Bundle?[/h3]

We are celebrating ten years of party games by releasing all of our Party Pack titles into one big bundle! That’s right! 50 games from Party Packs 1-10 for one low price of $199.99!

Play fan favorites like Quiplash, Trivia Murder Party, and Tee K.O. with your grandma! Or some hidden gems like Job Job, Role Models, or Monster Seeking Monster with that one coworker who smells like corn chips! The possibilities are truly endless!

[url=https://shop.jackboxgames.com/collections/staging-bundles/products/the-jackbox-decade-bundle][img]https://shop.jackboxgames.com/cdn/shop/files/laptop_quiplash_1024x1024@2x.jpg?v=1712185770[/img][/url]

[h3]Where can I buy the Jackbox Decade Bundle?[/h3]

The Jackbox Decade Bundle is available on Sony consoles, Microsoft consoles, Nintendo Switch, and Steam. Only one player needs to own the bundle for everyone else to join together in the room or over video conferencing apps. And the best part is, with Jackbox Games, your phone is the controller, so there’s no special equipment required! Already own all our games? You’re amazing. The Jackbox Decade Bundle makes a great [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/a-guide-to-buying-jackbox-games-as-a-gift][b]gift[/b][/url] as well.

notes.content:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38172/The_Jackbox_Quintpack_20/]Good news! [i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0[/i] is out now![/url]
[h2]
What is [i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0[/i]?[/h2]

[i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0 [/i] is a collection of 25 fan-favorite Jackbox games from Party Packs 6 through 10 that are guaranteed to liven up any gathering for one low price. With just one click of a button, you can own our five most recent titles for $119.99! That’s a Party Pack for free, brother!

[h2]What games are included in [i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0[/i]?[/h2]

The games included in [i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0[/i] are:

Party Pack 6 (Trivia Murder Party 2, Joke Boat, dictionarium, Push the Button, & Role Models)
Party Pack 7 (Quiplash 3, Champ’d Up, Blather ‘Round, Talking Points, & The Devils and the Details)
Party Pack 8 (drawful Animate, Job Job, The Wheel of Enormous Proportions, Weapons Drawn, & The Poll Mine)

Party Pack 10 (Dodo Re Mi, Tee K.O. 2, Hypnotorious, FixyText, & Timejinx)
[h2]
How do I play [i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0[/i]?[/h2]

You can play [i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0[/i] on any major console, computer, or tablet. Only one friend needs to own the games and most games can be played with between 1 and 8 people. The best part? Your phone is your controller, so there’s no special equipment required, my friend.


[i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0[/i] is available on Steam starting RIGHT NOW!!

Is there a bundle with The Jackbox Games’ first five Party Packs?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9164/]Uh, duh! It’s [i]The Jackbox Party Quintpack[/i]! Complete your collection here.[/url]

notes.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 10 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i]The Jackbox Party Pack 10[/i] was released on October 19th, 2023. On November 16th, 2023, players can expect an update to their game, including some bug fixes and additional features. If you spot a problem with your game or have a feature request or question, please submit a support ticket to help.jackboxgames.com. 

We are also pleased to announce that for the first time in Jackbox history, [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 10[/i] will include complete localization in Brazilian Portuguese. This localization features fully translated text and Brazilian-specific content. Learn more about this update [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/introducing-brazilian-portuguese-in-the-jackbox-party-pack-10]here[/url].

To get this free update, simply install [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 10[/i].
What’s in the patch:

[h1]Global[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]

- Brazilian Portuguese localization added!
- Various localization improvements and bug fixes

[h1]Tee K.O. 2[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]Tee K.O. 2 includes the following feature updates:[/i]

- Audience and players can now button-mash at certain times in the game to trigger visual effects
- Text Descriptions accessibility setting allows players to caption their drawings
- Updated credits visual design

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]Tee K.O. 2 bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Refined Final Round experience
- Fixed bug around Final Round Winner drawing occasionally missing details
- Minor bug fixes

[h1]Timejinx[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]Timejinx includes the following updates:[/i]

- Added more content
- Updated audience scoring UI
- Updated text for Time Loop hints
- Added motion sensitivity toggle

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]Timejinx bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Typos and misspellings
- Same player game-specific bugs like intro skipping and hints not showing
- Minor bug fixes

[h1]FixyText[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]FixyText includes the following updates:[/i]

- Player cursors are shown on the game screen as well the controller during text editing moments
- Refined controller experience with 3 suggestions to cycle through in the writing moment, and fewer tool tips on waiting screens
- Improved game feedback in voting moments

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]FixyText bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Text input at the end of the timer is now represented on the game screen
- Text-to-speech voice for the French version has been replaced
- Minor bug fixes

[h1]Dodo Re Mi[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]Dodo Re Mi includes the following updates:[/i]

- New songs and new instruments
- Ability to unlock more instruments on a song
- Tutorial has more instruments to play
- New combo flame and audience survival rates in post-game screen

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]Dodo Re Mi bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Improved messaging in-game moments
- Minor bug fixes

[h1]Hypnotorious[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]Hypnotorious includes the following updates:[/i]

- Splitting content between rounds one and two
- Allowing players to switch groups during re-roll
- Players receive different hints
- Players can change their accusations

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]Hypnotorious bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Fixed player names staying onscreen during the grouping phase
- Fixed group labels during grouping reveal
- Fixed transition moments and timing

notes.title: Play New Party Pack 10 Games for Free During Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Play New Party Pack 10 Games for Free During Steam Next Fest

Jackbox Games is hitting the Steam Next Fest circuit again with two brand-new games! Head on over to Steam to try out a demo of [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-10][i]The Jackbox Party Pack 10[/i][/url] before [url=https://jackboxgames.com/blog/party-pack-10-release-date-announcement]the official release[/url] on Thursday, October 19th!

[b]About Steam Next Fest[/b]
Steam Next Fest is a multiday celebration where Steam users can try out game demos, chat with developers, watch livestreams, and learn more about The Jackbox Party Pack 10. 

[b]The fest begins on Monday, October 9th at 10 AM PT and ends on Monday, October 16th at 10 AM PT. [/b]During this window of time, you’ll be able to download The Jackbox Party Pack 10 demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216830/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_10/]from this Steam page[/url] and try out abbreviated rounds from two of the new games in the pack. Once the fest ends, the demo will no longer be available to be downloaded!

It’s the perfect chance to scope out some of your options before you plan your [url=https://jackboxgames.com/blog/terrifying-party-pack-10-halloween-party]Halloween party[/url] game night. The only spooky part is missing out! 

[b]In This Demo[/b]
The Next Fest demo will contain one round of two games in [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 10[/i]: [url=https://jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-10/fixytext][i]FixyText[/i][/url] and [url=https://jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-10/dodo-re-mi][i]Dodo Re Mi[/i][/url]. Each game will be available to play in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian Spanish, and Latin American Spanish. 

Note: If you play more than that round, you’ll start to see repeated content! These are not full games. [I][url=https://jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-10/tee-k-o-2]Tee K.O. 2[/url][/i], [i][url=https://jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-10/hypnotorious]Hypnotorious[/url][/i], and [url=https://jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-10/timejinx][i]Timejinx[/i][/url] are NOT included in this demo and will be locked from play in the game’s lobby.

After you try out the game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216830/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_10/][b]add it to your Steam wishlist[/b][/url] so you don’t miss alerts when the game is released or on sale in the future. The entire Pack will be available for play on October 19th. 

[b]Watch our Livestreams[/b]
We’ll be live on Steam twice during Next Fest. Join us for a chance to chat with the new Pack’s developers:
[list]
[*] Wednesday, October 11th at 3:30 PM CT/1:30 PM PT: FixyText Play-Through and Q&A 
[*] Friday, October 13th at 12:30 PM CT/10:30 AM PT: Dodo Re Mi Play-Through and Q&A
[/list]

We’re looking forward to sharing this new Party Pack with you! Click below to add to your wishlist.

 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216830/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_10/ style=button]WISHLIST NOW[/url]

notes.title: All Five Games Coming to The Jackbox Party Pack 10 - Wishlist Today!
notes.content:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216830/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_10/][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33030169/2a7724727936241d9b55be3bf07d6784393a95a7.png[/img][/url]

We’ve almost made another trip around the sun since The Jackbox Party Pack 9 was released and it’s time to dust off your space boots and get ready for the launch of The Jackbox Party Pack 10! A brand new pack of 5 party games is set to arrive this fall and blast your parties into another hilarious dimension.

The Jackbox Party Pack 10 will be available at launch in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian Spanish, and Latin American Spanish. These games are perfect for your family holidays, game nights with friends, work happy hour, or to play alongside your favorite streamer.

[h2]Here are the 5 games in The Jackbox Party Pack 10:[/h2]

[i][h1]Tee K.O 2[/h1][/i]

(Drawing, Writing): In Tee K.O. 2, return to T-Shirt Island, where the most hardened warriors in the world compete in a deadly fighting tournament. The drawing finger – not the fist – decides the victory! Tee K.O. 2 supports 3-8 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/get-a-first-look-at-an-early-version-of-tee-k-o-2-in-the-jackbox-party-pack-10/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer and first look video with RubberRoss below:
[previewyoutube=gF_MLy6b5gg;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=egOQAaUylUc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][i]FixyText[/i][/h1]

(Writing, Teamwork): FixyText is the Wild West of text-editing. In this chaotic game, everyone’s in a group chat, typing all at once to make the most memorable statement. And there’s no delete key. Take that auto-correct! FixyText supports 3-8 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/fixytext-is-the-second-game-coming-this-fall-in-the-jackbox-party-pack-10/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer and first look video with Outside Xbox below.
[previewyoutube=71Q0fzMiwCg;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=B0hyCEdSKfo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][i]Hypnotorious[/i][/h1]

(Hidden Identity, Roleplaying): Hypnotorious is a game with secret roles, tentative alliances and of course, silly answers to ridiculous questions. Who is on your side? Hypnotorious supports 4-8 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/hypnotorious-is-coming-to-the-jackbox-party-pack-10-this-fall/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=IUgQezHhHk8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=6rA-y7XLFys;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][i]Timejinx[/i][/h1]

(Trivia): In Timejinx, you’re a time traveler from the future competing in a high-stakes trivia night. Save your current timeline by answering questions about the past. Timejinx supports 1-8 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/timejinx-is-coming-to-the-jackbox-party-pack-10-this-fall-2/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=8uDGDc3_a2A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][i]Dodo Re Mi[/i][/h1]

(Music, Teamwork): In Dodo Re Mi, your phone is your instrument. You and your flock must make music together to escape the hungry jungle plant. Dodo Re Mi supports 1-9 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/dodo-re-mi-party-pack-ten/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer below.
